hooks.name: Log Kiro usage after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, remind the agent to record what Kiro feature mattered in docs/KIRO_USAGE.md, which feeds the required write-up.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. If any Kiro feature (spec, steering, hook, MCP, property test, power, agent) changed the outcome, add a short dated entry to docs/KIRO_USAGE.md: what happened, why it mattered, concrete result. Record only what actually happened.
